featured_reviews.name: chandresh sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Took multiple grooming appointments on different visits (haircut, beard, eyebrows), each costing around ₹650 per session.
The first visit was okay, the second was bad, and the third one was completely ruined.
During the third visit, I clearly tried to explain my hairstyle and grooming requirements using my own reference photo. Any customer knows their own face and preferences better than a stylist. Instead of listening, the stylist Fahim immediately started cutting, saying he had other appointments and was in a hurry.
The entire haircut was rushed in just 15 minutes. Seriously—₹650 and you can’t even spare 30–40 minutes to do the job properly or listen to the customer? There was no discussion, no consultation, no effort to understand my requirement.
When I questioned the result, Fahim started blaming my hair volume instead of accepting that he didn’t listen. My hair condition was the same as in my reference photo from months ago. This felt less like professional feedback and more like ego and excuse-making. The attitude was rude, arrogant, and dismissive, as if he thinks he’s the world’s best hair artist and customers don’t know anything. Reality check needed.
What made it worse:
No one from the salon came to discuss, resolve, or even acknowledge the issue. I was so frustrated that I had to leave the place without getting my beard done, and the haircut I was given looked completely uneven and unacceptable.
I immediately went to another salon the same day, where the stylist actually listened patiently, understood my requirement, corrected the haircut, and saved me from the weird look I was left with here. That salon proved one thing clearly—the problem was not my hair, it was the lack of professionalism and communication here.
If this salon continues treating customers like this—rushing, not listening, and showing arrogance—people will speak up and post honest reviews.
If you care about your appearance, your money, and basic respect as a customer,
avoid this place.
